summary: Saturday Shorts policy check: no new Shorts policy in November; the 2027 Partner Program change (already in notifications) and the 1 Oct originality update need nothing from us. Added one sourced topic (Arnold Schwarzenegger's $0-salary Twins deal, from this week's 8.4x breakout); no new proposals.
why: The Arnold breakout (383K views on a 45.6K-subscriber channel) is a celebrity-money story in a core format (secret_of_rich 1.87x our median, 133% kept past the hook), with every figure on A.V. Club and confirmed by NBC. Thanksgiving and US-interest topics were dropped: no sourced 'why' or demand reference, and the primary budget pages couldn't be read. No challenger: the queued first-second tests already cover tonight's numbers.

findings.title: No new Shorts policy in November; YPP changes start 1 Feb 2027
findings.detail: New applicants need 8,000 watch hours or 20M Shorts views in 90 days; Shorts ads only for channels with 10M Shorts views in 90 days. Long videos stay our realistic revenue path (owner notification unchanged).

findings.title: 1 Oct originality update: re-uploads lose Shorts reach; 'template-based bulk changes' don't count as original
findings.detail: We make our own scripts, animation and sound, so nothing changes; the variety and directed-shot rules are what keep us on the right side.

findings.title: Arnold took $0 for Twins and made over $40M, more than any film he made
findings.detail: $16.5M budget, 40% of the backend, $216M box office. Added as topic 2026-11-21-arnold-0-salary-twins-biggest-paycheck (score 8.08).

findings.detail: Disneyland worker vs ticket 981 views (103.7% viewed), McDonald's worker vs CEO 676 within hours. Only 2 data points, so it isn't a challenger yet; keep one lane-5 topic open.
